@iocanel FYI as well.
just to clarify - your title says "remote development" but I assume you just mean deployment of quarkus app fails in openshift and is not relate to what we refer to as remote devmode, right?

It's a remote dev mode because a mutable jar needs to be deployed to the OpenShift as running a remote dev mode. However, a mutable jar can't be accessed like the above screenshot when I deployed it via Quarkus OpenShift extension. Hope it helps you clarify the issue. Thanks.

body:
I just tried to retest this in 1.10.5.Final then it still doesn't work since remote-dev keep trying to trigger the entire S2I processor rather than sending changed classes when I change the code. Also, the environment variable(QUARKUS_LAUNCH_DEVMODE=true) which I set in DC manually is removed during the new S2I processor based on Openshift extension. This occurs connection failure like:

2021-01-04 15:46:29,661 ERROR [io.qua.ver.htt.dep.dev.HttpRemoteDevClient] (Remote dev client thread) Remote dev request failed: java.io.IOException: Server did not start a remote dev session
        at io.quarkus.vertx.http.deployment.devmode.HttpRemoteDevClient$Session.doConnect(HttpRemoteDevClient.java:128)
        at io.quarkus.vertx.http.deployment.devmode.HttpRemoteDevClient$Session.run(HttpRemoteDevClient.java:169)
        at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:832)

2021-01-04 15:46:29,662 ERROR [io.qua.ver.htt.dep.dev.HttpRemoteDevClient] (Remote dev client thread) Connection failed after 10 retries, exiting

Can we set "QUARKUS_LAUNCH_DEVMODE=true" in application.properties for openshift extension? It takes more time to send a changed code to the remote server(OCP) than I deployed the same quarkus app using a binary build/deployment.
